rootCause: MULTIPLE answer values are stored as JSON text in the question table and in raw revision archives, while the live after-state projection is a JSON array. The initial generated SQL compared the live logical array with the raw serialized proposal, so three rows whose content had been written could not receive the applied_at marker and were reported as BASELINE_CHANGED.
resolution: Normalized MULTIPLE proposal answers to logical arrays only for live after-state comparisons, while preserving the serialized proposal in revision archives and hashes. The guarded preflight confirmed exact revision archives and exact live after content; rerunning the corrected segment completed all 26 archive markers.
notes: The original apply command reported a partial status-check failure after the database transaction and did not write the normal application report.
The final application report records exact after-state matching, complete applied revision archives, unchanged answer/exam history checksums, and idempotence.
No human approval or release approval is asserted.
